Guidance & outlook: FY26 was a milestone year for Indegene on 2 fronts, Q4 FY26 was the first ever quarter in our history where our revenues exceeded ₹1,000 crores.
And FY27 is where we expect it to convert into visible growth and we are hoping this customer is going to cross over and become our first $50 million-plus customer.

We closed FY26 with a cash and investment position of approximately ₹15,385 million, just ₹1,258 million lower than FY25 despite ₹7,253 million of outflows towards the acquisitions that we made during the year.
Growth & demand: Our growth for the year in INR terms was 23.6% and in dollar terms 18.2% YoY.
Across the top 20 as a group, revenue grew from ₹22,082 million to ₹25,200 million in FY26, steady, compounding expansion driven by portfolio breadth and recurring engagements.
For the full year, the revenue was ₹35,105 million, reflecting a 23.6% growth in INR terms and 18.2% in USD terms, ahead of FY25 on both measures.
Margins & costs: Our Q4 adjusted EBITDA came in at ₹1,889 million, growing 23.2% year-over-year.
The full year adjusted EBITDA totalled ₹6,793 million, up 20.8% year- on-year.
Further, you will also recollect the investments that we made, resulting in 150 basis points impact on our EBITDA margins, that we mentioned 2 quarters ago.
Capex & expansion: There was a bit of a hold due to a delay in a highly anticipated breakthrough as we continue to invest in the relationship.
